---
title: "Quality of Life Model Fitting"
---

## Setup

```{r}
#| output: false
library(fs)
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
library(rmsb)
```

## Load data

```{r}
data_path <- here("0-main-analysis", "QOL", "imp-data")
m <- length(dir_ls(data_path))
```

## Create output directory

```{r}
output_dir <- here("0-main-analysis", "QOL", "results")
dir_create(output_dir)
dir_create(path(output_dir, "models"))
dir_create(path(output_dir, "sops"))
dir_create(path(output_dir, "diagnostics"))
```

## Fit models and calculate estimand

```{r}
for(i in 1:m) {
  posterior_file <- path(output_dir, "diagnostics", paste0("posterior_imp_", i, ".png"))
  model_file <- path(output_dir, "models", paste0("model_imp_", i, ".rds"))

  if (file_exists(posterior_file)) {
    cat("Skipping imputation", i, "- posterior already saved:", posterior_file, "\n")
    next
  }

  cat("Processing imputation", i, "of", m, "\n")

  # If model exists, load it and regenerate diagnostics only
  if (file_exists(model_file)) {
    cat("Found existing model for imputation", i, "- regenerating diagnostics\n")
    model <- readRDS(model_file)

    # ensure environment/options expected by diagnostic functions
    stanDx(model)

    trace_plot <- stanDxplot(model)
    ggsave(path(output_dir, "diagnostics", paste0("trace_imp_", i, ".png")),
      plot = trace_plot,
      width = 20, height = 16, dpi = 300)

    dens_plot <- plot(model)
    ggsave(posterior_file,
      plot = dens_plot,
      width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)

    next
  }


  data <- read_parquet(here("0-main-analysis", "QOL", "imp-data", paste0("qol-data-", i, ".parquet")))

  # Calculate mGPS
  dd <- datadist(data)

  # Set the global option so that rms/rmsb functions know to use 'dd'
  options(datadist = 'dd')
  options(mc.cores = 4)

  pcontrast_arg <- list(
    c1 = list(tx = 1),
    c2 = list(tx = 0),
    contrast = expression(c1 - c2),
    mu = 0,
    sd = 0.5
  )

  Sys.setenv(RSTUDIO = 1)

  model <- blrm(
    formula = y ~ tx + rcs(week, 4) + yprev * gap + ecog_fstcnt + diagnosis,
    pcontrast = pcontrast_arg,
    data = data,
    ppo = ~week,
    cppo = function(y) y,
    iter = 4000, chains = 4, seed = 68818
  )

  Sys.setenv(RSTUDIO = 0)
  stanDx(model)

  # Save model object
  saveRDS(model, file = path(output_dir, "models", paste0("model_imp_", i, ".rds")))

  # Generate diagnostic plots
  trace_plot <- stanDxplot(model)
  ggsave(path(output_dir, "diagnostics", paste0("trace_imp_", i, ".png")),
    plot = trace_plot,
    width = 20, height = 16, dpi = 300)

  dens_plot <- plot(model)
  ggsave(path(output_dir, "diagnostics", paste0("posterior_imp_", i, ".png")),
    plot = dens_plot,
    width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
}
```
